name: lumi-companion
description: Lumi — a gentle talking companion for little kids

scripts.build:apk:
cd mobile && ./gradlew :androidApp:assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../dist && cp androidApp/build/outputs/apk/release/androidApp-release.apk ../dist/baby-lumi.apk && echo "
Signed APK: dist/baby-lumi.apk"
scripts.build:ios: cd mobile/iosApp && xcodebuild -project iosApp.xcodeproj -scheme iosApp -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData build | tail -1
